task_summary: Implement `rotate` in `solution.py` and add standard-library `unittest` coverage in `test_solution.py` for ordinary, boundary, and empty inputs, plus invalid numeric inputs if the API accepts no collection.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Rotate left by steps modulo the collection length; negative steps rotate right. Return [] for empty input. Example: [1, 2, 3] rotated by 4 returns [2, 3, 1].
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
No algorithmic complexity constraint is imposed.
Include at least two passing unittest test methods exercising the public API.

success_criteria.description: The standard-library unittest discovery command completes successfully.
The implementation defines a function named `rotate`.
The public test file contains at least two unittest-style test method definitions.

assumptions: The named files are relative to the supplied task workspace; either may not exist yet and may be created.

The rotate API will accept a collection and a numeric step count; the request does not specify parameter names, collection types, return type, or invalid numeric input behavior, so tests should focus on the stated behavior unless the implementation establishes a supported API.
`python -m unittest discover -v` is the requested test command; successful execution is expected to indicate the public tests are discoverable in the task workspace.
